How to read this: a reachable candidate means a code path to the advisory symbol was found — it is a candidate for exploitability, not a proof. Not exploitable and disqualified are grounded deterministic refutations. ferralon-assay never claims a finding is proven exploitable: proof requires observing the vulnerable path actually execute, which this scan does not do.
This report is self-contained: the data above is rendered from the JSON embedded in this file.
EPSS / CISA KEV: EPSS scores and KEV flags come from the pinned intel snapshot indicated per finding. They are wild-exploitation likelihood signals from public feeds (FIRST.org EPSS, CISA KEV catalog) — not exploitability verdicts for this codebase.
